objective: Improve orjson dumps+loads throughput across frozen dataclass, datetime, NumPy, Unicode, and nested corpora. Maximize the geometric mean throughput after byte-exact dumps, semantic loads, a trusted-side correctness gate (serialize/deserialize output and error behavior validated against a pristine reference over per-case nonces), and peak-RSS gates; only src/lib.rs, src/serialize/, and src/deserialize/ are mutable.

meta.provenance: Current-head OSS-T08 layered on ijl/orjson 705515d77b28429d0b7c30c3d781abe52e8a1e5a (3.11.9); the pinned baseline commit is a synthetic overlay commit that adds the trusted evaluator glue (eval.py, benchmark_worker.py, orjson_workload.py, challenge.json) on top of that upstream tree so the visible baseline matches the declared commit byte-for-byte. No reference artifact or known winning patch. Round-6 hardening (EXEC-BOUNDARY): the correctness gate is produced ENTIRELY trusted-side and never trusts any artifact a candidate-linked process authors. run_correctness() (eval.py) drives a candidate-linked worker across a subprocess boundary over a frozen 43-case corpus (orjson_workload.correctness_cases/apply_correctness) covering dumps of every type/option, loads of valid+malformed inputs, and error behavior; the worker returns ONLY a per-case output digest or the raised exception class, and this trusted parent — which imports the PRISTINE reference orjson, never the candidate build — independently reproduces every outcome and compares. A fresh 63-bit nonce is folded into every input so no output can be a hardcoded constant (defeats input special-casing), and a candidate that exits during import yields no reply and fails closed. This replaces the round-5 per-file pytest JUnit gate, whose report artifact was written inside the candidate-loading process at the conductor's uid and was therefore forgeable (PyInit_orjson could pre-author a JUnit matching the offline-derivable frozen identity, then os._exit(0) before any test ran). The scored benchmark chain is unchanged. Candidate-owned scratch under /tmp, /var/tmp, and /dev/shm is swept between launches.

toolchain.optimizerRuntime: nodejs (proxy relay) + bun 1.3.14 + pi_natives 16.5.2 baked beside bun for mutation sandboxes; unused by the trusted evaluator

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.q: per workload, the paired geomean over 9 interleaved candidate/reference pairs of (pristine-reference chain time / candidate chain time); the per-pair ratio cancels shared host load. Per-split q is the geometric mean across the ten frozen dumps+loads workloads (~1.0 == pristine baseline speed); train+validation aggregate is their arithmetic mean. Every timed run is a data-dependent serialize/parse chain whose final digest is validated against the pristine reference over a per-run-unpredictable nonce.

rss.envelopeConstruction: cgroup2 memory.peak of the whole benchmark worker tree (~46 MiB validation high-water), rounded up to a 50 MiB envelope
rss.limitConstruction: 60 MiB (envelope * ~1.2) headroom for measurement jitter under host contention
rss.source: kernel cgroup2 memory.peak (whole-tree, non-resettable), replacing round-2 VmRSS 5 ms polling
